messages:
alex: Heads-up: saw two model onboard failures this morning tied to KV cache format changes after post-quantization. One caused a silent latency spike on tail.

maria: Can you paste the error logs? Is it the KV deserialization step?

alex: Log snippet:
```
ERROR runtime.kv: invalid kv header v=3 expected=4 model=llama-65b-q4
Traceback: RuntimeError: kv-deserialize-failed
Latency: p50=280ms p95=920ms (normal p95~300ms)
```

cheng: That looks like a version mismatch. Do we have a migration shim? We currently assume cache_version==runtime_version.

alex: No shim. Onboard pipeline writes kv_format in manifest but runtime only accepts matching versions unless a compat table exists.

sara: Short-term: fail-fast in ingest with explicit compat check + quarantine the model. Long-term: we need healthcheck probes that exercise the KV lookup path under realistic prefixes.

patrick: Agree. Add a KV liveness probe that replays sampled prefixes (small token windows) and measures correctness + p50/p95. Reuse golden inputs from bench harness.

maria: Tradeoffs: probe frequency vs cost. If we run heavy probes on every deploy that's expensive. Gate probes to new or changed artifacts, and only re-run on quantization or runtime changes.

cheng: Also consider canary routing: route 1% of real traffic to the new runtime variant and compare kv hit rates + tail latency before full rollout.

alex: Proposal we can ship quickly:
1) On ingest: manifest vs runtime compat check (fail-fast).
2) Run KV healthcheck: replay N=10 golden prefixes, record hit/miss, correctness checksum, and p50/p95 latency.
3) If checksum mismatch or p95 > threshold -> mark model quarantine + auto-rollout-block.
4) Runtime exposes /kv/health endpoint for periodic probes and external monitoring.

sara: +1. Add an alerting signal `kv_compat_failures` with model id + artifact sha and a short histogram of latencies.

patrick: Implementation notes: leverage existing bench infra to pick golden prefixes per model family. Add a lightweight runner inside onboarding container that can execute under the quantized runtime binary. Make results idempotent and short-lived.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: queued canary test job: onboard-kv-healthcheck-1708001234 for model llm-x-2024-03

alex: We should track regressions over time. Create time-series metric `kv_replay_p95_by_model` and surface in rollout dashboards + SLO.

maria: I'll draft a concise RFC with the metrics, thresholds, and the API shape for `/kv/health` + example payloads. Will ping for review tomorrow.

cheng: One more: snapshot kv cache schema and schema_version in the model artifact (manifest + checksum) so offline validators and analytics can assert compatibility.

alex: Cool. For now I quarantined the two affected models and disabled auto-roll for builds touching the runtime kernel. Thanks all :thumbsup:
